sections.team: Who turns up at your door

emergency.closedNow: Outside office hours — emergency line open
emergency.immediateSteps: What you can do right now

serviceArea.heading: Where we work
serviceArea.mapNote: A static image instead of a Google Maps embed: an embed loads data to the US before anyone has consented.
serviceArea.radius: We work in {city} and the municipalities within roughly {km} kilometres. If your address falls outside that, call anyway — we know the businesses in the region and will point you to one.

quote.title: Request a quote

hints.postalCode: We only need the postcode, to check whether we cover your area.
hints.phone: A phone call is fastest. One number is enough.
hints.photos: A photo often saves a site visit — and saves you the cost of one. Up to {max} images.

quote.submittingNote: Please don't reload. This rarely takes more than a few seconds.
quote.privacyNote: Your details are used only to handle this request and are sent straight to our office. We do not store them on this website and do not pass them on.

success.title: Thank you, we have your request
success.body: You'll hear from us, usually within 24 hours. If it's urgent, call us as well: {phone}

error.title: That didn't work
error.body: Your details are still in the form. Try again — or simply call us: {phone}

validation.summaryTitle: Please check {count, plural, one {one entry} other {# entries}}
validation.phoneRequired: Please give us a phone number — without one we cannot call you back.
validation.emailInvalid: This address looks incomplete. Is something missing after the @?
validation.postalCodeInvalid: A Swiss postcode has four digits.
validation.contactRequired: Please leave either a phone number or an email address.
validation.fileTooLarge: “{name}” is too large. Please keep images under {max} MB.

quote.leadSteps: {count, plural, one {One short step} other {# short steps}}, about two minutes. You'll usually have an answer within 24 hours — on weekdays typically much sooner.

contact.outsideHoursBody: The emergency line is open around the clock: {phone}. Call it rather than emailing — nobody reads email until morning.
contact.formLead: For a quote the form is the best route — you can attach photos, which often saves us a site visit.

consent.title: We use only what is necessary
consent.body: This website works without advertising or tracking cookies. For traffic measurement we use an anonymous, cookieless method. You decide whether we may.

notwendig.label: Necessary
notwendig.description: Needed to run the website — and to remember this choice. Cannot be switched off.

funktional.label: Functional
funktional.description: Extras such as embedded maps or video.

statistik.label: Statistics
statistik.description: Anonymous, cookieless traffic measurement. The site works exactly the same if you decline.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Not in use on this website.

consent.savedRejectedBody: We've recorded your refusal. This website now makes no third-party requests.
consent.recordNote: We record the time, the version of this policy and your choice — locally in your browser. This record is not sent to a server.

noReviews.title: No reviews yet
noReviews.body: We've only recently appeared on Google. Were you a customer? A short note helps the next person decide.

noProjects.title: The gallery is being built
noProjects.body: We've only recently started photographing our sites systematically. Call us — we'll gladly show you comparable work.

noJobs.title: No positions advertised right now
noJobs.body: We hire when the right person turns up, not only when a position is open. Drop us a line.

errors.notFoundBody: We may have renamed it. If it's urgent, just call — we'll work out what you need faster on the phone.
errors.serverErrorTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errors.serverErrorBody: Not on yours. Try again in a few minutes — or call, that always works: {phone}

demo.barText: Unofficial preview — not this business's live website. Not indexed in search engines.
